All four direct call sites of `AuthToken::validate` now have the debug line immediately before them:

- `src/auth/auth_service.cpp` — `AuthService::login`
- `src/web/session_controller.cpp` — `SessionController::handle`
- `src/web/auth_controller.cpp` — `AuthController::handleLogin` and `AuthController::handleRefresh`

`AuthService::validate` (the other `validate` overload) was excluded since it doesn't call `AuthToken::validate`. All three files already include `<iostream>`.
